set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/atlas. Acceptance: split AtlasRef into representation-specific volume/surface/derived refs or equivalent typed representation parameter; type SpaceId by volume/surface/unknown kind; separate route-available transform plans from executable coordinate transform plans; make provenance artifact roles typed; add typed region labels/attributes; expose Either-based query/reduce/overlap constructors while keeping unsafe conveniences only where intentional. Verification: atlasJVM/test and atlasJS/test plus atlas example compile if affected.
set.title: Type atlas representations, spaces, transforms, and provenance
